title: SAT Quadratics: Vertex, Roots, and the Discriminant
description:
Quadratics are a core part of Advanced Math on the digital SAT. This lesson shows the three forms of a quadratic and what each one reveals, then works through every common question type with six SAT-style practice questions.

You'll learn:
• Standard, factored, and vertex form, and which one to use
• Factoring and the quadratic formula (plus a Desmos check)
• The discriminant: two, one, or no real solutions
• Maximum and minimum word problems
• The sum and product of the solutions

All practice questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank (Advanced Math).
